Summary of side-effect commands:
- `$ npm test -- --reporter=default tests/unit/projection-adapter.test.js tests/integration/core-router.test.js`
- `$ npm test`

I implemented F002 as a thin view-adapter layer rather than rewriting any page: a new pure module `dashboard/lib/projection-adapter.js` validates the F001 `state-snapshot.json` envelope (schema_version pinned to `1.0`), extracts the canonical streams under JS-style keys (`plans`, `gates`, `inbox`, `supervisors`, `quota`, `decisions`, `evidenceRefs`, `snapshotMeta`), and synthesises the legacy `tasks` / `agents` / `activity` shapes consumed by mission-control and command-center so those pages render the projection without per-page changes. `dashboard/core.js` was extended to fetch `state/state-snapshot.json` after the legacy loaders and call `mergeSnapshotIntoState`, so the snapshot wins when present and legacy demo files render when it is absent (acceptance #1, #2, #4); the Capability Center's `capabilities-status.json` path is intentionally untouched, satisfying acceptance #3.
